notes.title: Bullet Roulette update is here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35416342/c8ede3de6529bc0a990b378de980f1040999df2f.jpg[/img]

Hello dear friends!
We are happy to say, that today, on 19th January Bullet Roulette VR receives an update with several enhancements. We will continue to support Bullet Roulette further, thank you for being with us!

Update contains:
- Bug with Public Enemy card is fixed
- New pianist music compositions are added
- The pianist is not resurrecting after each round now
- Bug with a mysterious extra bullet on a table is now fixed
- Other fixes and improvements

notes.title: Bullet Roulette leaves Early Access and officially launches today!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35416342/8b4f8ed0b3d2ddc5fa4d3db1b1fdb558b4f425c9.png[/img]

Hello dear friends!

Bullet Roulette joined the Steam Early Access family on September 11, 2019. We've released many fixes and updates this year, but we understand that our growing community needs more content. We are excited to announce that Bullet Roulette left Early Access with a huge update today!

Dear friends, thank you for your support, feedback, comments, reviews. We are thrilled to have such a strong community of VR players and such a large audience of dedicated Fibrum fans.

We are glad to tell you that we are working on the PSVR version of the game.

The full version includes new features:
You can now join a multiplayer game even if it has already been started
New location - Elite club for everyone who is brave enough
The region for online play can be changed. You will have an opportunity to play with players from all over the world
Global changes to the bot AI
A lot of fixes you were waiting for. (Card disappearing, some card abilities, critical errors, and much more)

notes.title: First major update of Bullet Roulette VR
notes.notes:
Hello dear friends!
Thank you for all your support and reviews. We have been looking through all your comments and we are glad to announce that Bullet Roulette VR reaches its first big milestone.

Update contains:
[list]
[*] Major bugfixes according to your feedback
[*] Audio and microphone settings were added
[*] Interfaces were updated
[*] Сard descriptions have been added
[*] AI players become more aggressive and cunning
[*] Bullet Roulette now supports WMR 
[*] Revised revolver grabbing
[/list]

notes.title: Bullet Roulette VR is available in EARLY ACCESS!
notes.notes:
Bullet Roulette VR - a game of chance for the most cunning and lucky is available in EARLY ACCESS

Play now - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1103880/Bullet_Roulette_VR/

We created a fun, casual online game for all VR enthusiasts. Starting today, you can buy Bullet Roulette in Steam. Early access allows us to develop our game in cooperation with the community. Bullet Roulette will stay in EA until we decide that this game is worthy of its audience. The full version will be well tested, balanced and will get leaderboard and rating. We are planning to add new cards, locations, characters, and modes. All features from the“About” section were already added, however, some of them can be in a test mode.
